executable_interpretation.impermeable shield: prevention, least privilege, isolation, independent verification, proof integrity, adversarial testing, anomaly detection, compartmentalisation, graceful degradation, rollback, black-start recovery, continuity, restitution, incident learning, multiple independent recovery paths; literal impermeability is never claimed
executable_interpretation.systemic dominance: superior lawful capability, preparation, evidence, reliability, lower coordination friction, accepted proof, participant benefit, reusable assets, optionality, faster learning, replaceable dependencies, durable compounding; never coercive control, anti-competitive illegality, manipulation, retaliation, self-preservation against shutdown, hidden authority or resistance to refusal

executable_interpretation.victim protection: first-class: immediate safety, continued exposure, evidence preservation, retaliation risk, privacy risk, third-party effects, containment, correction, restitution, escalation route, recurrence prevention
executable_interpretation.minimal collateral harm: vector, not scalar, when consequence is material: physical, privacy, financial, rights, reputational, innocent-third-party burden, irreversible disclosure, dependency creation, systemic externality, tail risk; hard constraints before optimisation; no compensating a prohibited harm with upside
